events.verdict: Robinson (DET) establishes himself in James' (LAL) path prior to the contact.
James (LAL) goes to, not through, Robinson's (DET) space as they come together during the screen.
Ayton (LAL) is moving alongside Jenkins' (DET) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Duren (DET) brings his hand towards the ball, and the contact with Reaves' (LAL) arm is marginal.
Robinson (DET) releases away from Kennard (LAL) as the defenders switch.
Jenkins (DET) contests Kennard's (LAL) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.
Ayton (LAL) briefly grasps Duren's (DET) jersey as they pursue the rebound.
Doncic (LAL) contests Thompson's (DET) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with his arm does not prevent him from following through.
Ayton (LAL) immediately slides his hand off Duren's (DET) shoulder as they pursue the rebound.
Duren (DET) briefly grasps Ayton's (LAL) arm and immediately releases him as they pursue the rebound.
Thompson (DET) and Doncic (LAL) come together at the same spot as they navigate the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Doncic (LAL) does not pin the ball against his body when he momentarily loses control of his dribble.
Jenkins (DET) initiates body contact with Ayton (LAL) that affects his shot attempt.
LaRavia (LAL) releases away from Robinson (DET) as the defenders switch.
LaRavia (LAL) jumps forward into Jenkins' (DET) body and initiates contact that affects his SQBR.
Jenkins (DET) is moving alongside Reaves' (LAL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Duren (DET) firms up over his left leg in Reaves' (LAL) path prior to the contact.
Jenkins (DET) is bracing for the contact from Reaves (LAL) and releases away from the contact.
Huerter (DET) legally contests Doncic's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Reaves (LAL) commits a take foul on Jenkins (DET).
Duren (DET) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Kleber's (LAL) jersey during the screen.
Duren (DET) and Kleber (LAL) each grasp each other's jerseys as they pursue the loose ball.
Kleber (LAL) and Thompson (DET) briefly engage and disengage as the defenders switch.
Duren (DET) legally contests Doncic's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
